description: Did that X1 payment really land? Payer, how much reached the wallet you name in XNT or any SPL token (by balance change, so program-sent payments count), confirmed vs finalized, memos and fee, checked against what you expected. $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

expect.description: optional expected amount in whole units, e.g. 0.5

mint.description: optional SPL token mint; omit for native XNT

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: x1_payment_check
